title: relativeTime
responsibility: Formats an instant relative to a supplied reference time for the revision picker.

inputs.name: relativeTime.instant
inputs.description: Recorded timestamp to parse. A missing or invalid timestamp returns Unknown.

inputs.name: relativeTime.now
inputs.description: Reference time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

outputs.name: relativeTime
outputs.description: Localized relative date or Unknown when the recorded timestamp is unavailable.
